question: Can a group-aware candidate make each complete rollout either emitted exactly once within a valid microbatch or explicitly dropped whole, while preserving fixed-count semantics and accepting feasible token packings?

contract.fixed_count: Every emitted microbatch contains exactly microbatch_size rows. Do not split a rollout. If a contiguous prefix cannot be completed within capacity, drop whole rollouts and record their total row count; do not emit an underfilled batch.
contract.token_budget: Every emitted microbatch has one or more samples on every rank; each rank is within token_budget. A rollout is either wholly represented in one microbatch or wholly rejected with counted rows. Exact-feasible single-rollout packings in the frozen fixtures must be found.

success_rule: Pinned base must fail at least one whole-group invariant on fixed_boundary/token_boundary. Candidate must pass all eight cases, including exact fixed-count batch sizes, explicit whole-rollout drop accounting, exact-fit token group retention, rank nonemptiness and per-row limits.
rejection_rule: Any partial rollout, split rollout, missing row without a whole-group drop count, duplicate emission, underfilled fixed-count microbatch, empty rank, token-budget violation, or rejection of exact-fit T fails.

method.execution: AST-extract _balance_by_squared_length and both pinned production batcher class definitions; stub only IterableDataset and logger. No copied method implementation.
method.comparison: Run unchanged script in pinned base and candidate source checkout.

claim_limits: Finite source-level contract tests only; no Trainer, optimizer, distributed collectives, throughput, or task success.
A pass supports the group accounting contract on these frozen fixtures, not general packing optimality.
